turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm writing a book review for school. How should I structure it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start with a short summary without spoilers, then say what worked and what didn't, and end with who you'd recommend it to.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long should the summary be?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep it brief, maybe a paragraph. The teacher mostly wants your opinion and your reasons.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I didn't like the ending but

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm not sure if I'm allowed to say that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Of course you are. Just explain why, like it felt rushed or it didn't fit the characters.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It totally felt rushed. Should I use quotes from the book?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: One or two short ones are great to back up your points. Don't use too many, though.
